title: Thea Care: The dermatologist-built AI closing skincare's advice gap
summary: A shopper clicks on a skincare ad, lands on a page with 40 products and no one to ask. Most leave the shop without buying. Those who buy pick one product instead of a routine, and if it's the wrong one, they don't come back. Thea Care, a Berlin-based company, gives skincare brands the advisor their online shop is missing: a dermatologist-built AI skin analysis that runs under the brand's own name.
